conventions.convention: Use SI units, identify the mathematical G with G_N, and hold the asymptotic generator ξ=∂x⁰ fixed with x⁰=ct∞ and g(ξ,ξ) tending to −1 at infinity.
Adopt a zero-mode-excluded, zero-point-subtracted, two-polarization photon Gibbs reservoir and separately specified isotropic ray transport. Exported entropy is coarse Gibbs/ray entropy.
The effective far-field area is ηA_H with constant 0<η≤1, incoming flux is zero, and the model terminates at its first strictly positive cutoff 0<M_min<M_0.
Define t_cross=r_H/c and ε_qs=|M′|t_cross/M throughout the closed interval [0,τ], including M(τ)=M_min>0. This is an internal ODE diagnostic, not a backreaction error estimate.
Assume Countable Choice explicitly; no full Axiom of Choice is asserted. The stationary-family entropy offset and mathematical accounting offset need not agree; only their differences are identified.
The half-mass specialization takes η=1 and M_min=M_0/2. Its algebraic zero-mass time t_* is a scale beyond the stipulated cutoff, not a physical extinction prediction.

load_bearing.statement: On the fixed-normalization positive-mass Schwarzschild family, adopt T∞=ℏc³/(8πG_NMk_B), A_eff=ηA_H, P∞=A_eff σT∞⁴, c²M′=−P∞, and S_rad′=(4/3)P∞/T∞ with S_rad(0)=0, for constant 0<η≤1 and a positive first cutoff 0<M_min<M_0. Adopt the specified ideal photon Gibbs/ray reservoir under Countable Choice.

Assuming the ideal fixed-reference model, Countable Choice, G=G_N, and the area-entropy calibration interface with its actual hypotheses: α=ηℏc⁴/(15360πG_N²), M(t∞)=(M_0³−3αt∞)^(1/3), τ=(M_0³−M_min³)/(3α), energy export is c²(M_0−M_min), S_H(M)=4πk_BG_NM²/(ℏc)+s_*, S_rad(τ)=(4/3)ΔS_H>0, and Δ(S_H+S_rad)=(1/3)ΔS_H>0. The maximum diagnostic is 2G_Nα/(c³M_min²).

Under Countable Choice and the fixed-reference mathematical emitter model, define t_cross(t∞)=r_H(M(t∞))/c and ε_qs(t∞)=|M′(t∞)|t_cross(t∞)/M(t∞) for every t∞∈[0,τ], including its positive-mass cutoff endpoint.

Under Countable Choice and the stated positive-cutoff ODE data, ε_qs=2Gα/(c³M²)≤2Gα/(c³M_min²). For ε_0>0, M_min²≥2Gα/(c³ε_0) implies ε_qs≤ε_0 on [0,τ]. If 0≤t∞≤t∞+Δt≤τ and δ=3αΔt/M(t∞)³≤1/2, then M(t∞+Δt)/M(t∞)=(1−δ)^(1/3) and its difference from one has absolute value at most (2^(2/3)/3)δ.

published_dependencies.used_for: Checked the exact axiom: every sequence of nonempty sets admits a choice function. The assigned items explicitly carry this premise from their photon-spectrum and stationary-family suppliers.

Checked the endpoint-difference theorem with continuity on [a,b], differentiability on (a,b), and a<b. The quasistatic-bounds proof handles δ=0 separately and applies it to h(x)=(1−x)^(1/3) on [0,δ] when δ>0.

concerns.concern: The opening Postulate paragraph says: “In [[prop-tgr-ideal-evaporation-accounting]], the mathematical constant G is identified with this same G_N.” That linked mathematical supplier is absent from both deps and dependency_roles, and is not otherwise declared as a reference. The supplier exists and its interface matches; the concern is the undeclared supplier used to formulate this cross-interface identification.

seams_checked.note: Compared the consumer claims with the actual draft photon-flux theorem and accounting proposition, including their proofs. The zero-mode exclusion, two polarizations, independent ray convention, σ=π²k_B⁴/(60ℏ³c²), entropy flux factor 4/3, fixed reference, positive cutoff, and free entropy offset are preserved. Conversely, the supplier page explicitly limits its scope to mathematical trace/ray and ODE deductions; the consumer does not promote them to observed horizon emission or an equilibration theorem. The undeclared postulate link is recorded separately.

Compared the reversible-identification postulate and area-entropy theorem with the consumer's Statement, L1, and proof step 1.3. The consumer retains the strictly subextremal zero-magnetic-flux stationary family, Countable Choice, adopted reversible heat, selected same-generator reduced-temperature identification, and free entropy offset. The Schwarzschild specialization m=G_NM/c²>0, a=q=0 lies inside that domain. Conversely, the supplier provides a family state function rather than a dynamical entropy law; the consumer explicitly treats evaluation along M(t∞) as conditional bookkeeping.
